summary:
The MASTER-NFT-PROJECT web layer is a ~290-file ES-module application (ethers 6.15 vendored, no framework) whose single shell (web/confluence/app.js, 1,467 lines) routes eight destinations: Swap (web/v4, Uniswap v4 with a RAILGUN shielded default), Launch (web/launchpad, 1,664-line desk + 1,326-line LaunchChain), Vault/Live (web/genesis/live-*.mjs driving NativeMarket, TimeVault, MemoryLedger, WorldLedger and VestedExitVault through the token's SovereignAccount), Memory (encrypted journals, 600,000-round PBKDF2 + AES-GCM), Commons (on-chain WorldLedger rooms, a custom P-256 envelope chat, and an RFC 9420 MLS chat via ts-mls 1.6.4), Worlds (commissioned cartridges and a loopback world server), Atlas (an action index) and Advanced (session grants, ERC-8004 binding, markets, agents, Groth16 proof desk). A separate 707,014-byte Module Workbench runs third-party modules in nonce-CSP sandboxed iframes with a bounded host API (anima.host/1) and journals state on chain.

The UI is delivered from chain: ConfluenceRenderer's tokenURI returns a data:application/json whose animation_url is a data:text/html loader generated from web/confluence/chain-loader.mjs + module-loader.mjs (compiled into contracts/src/confluence/ConfluenceLoader.sol). The loader carries window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY, reads the 101-chunk / 117-module / 20-group archive with raw eth_call through the user's HTTPS RPC or window.ethereum at one pinned block, verifies SHA-256 in pure JS, gunzips with DecompressionStream, builds an import map of data: URLs and document.write()s the 7,952,983-byte app (recovered in 6,080 ms in the acceptance run). The same bytes are also built to dist/index.html for development. There is no web3:// route and no page-level CSP; marketplaces must allow data-HTML execution and a CORS RPC.

Ownership gating is in-app and repeated, not at the door: ConfluenceWallet.connect binds to the minted identity, requires ownerOf(tokenId)==signer, the ERC-6551-style account and all six module addresses to have code, and re-asserts owner/currentOwner/mode()==0/sessionEpoch before every signed action; NFTAccountSession (launchpad) pins the collection and account runtime bytecode with immutable masks and wraps plans into executeUtility with an atomic exact ERC-20 allowance; RegistryAdapter (workbench) additionally requires currentOwner==ownerOf; cartridges are launched only if CartridgeRegistry.launchManifest(id, player) reports authorized and sha256(contentOf)==contentHash. However the Swap desk has no NFT check at all (RAILGUN or injected wallet), and Commons/MLS, Governance, Crosschain, Lifecycle and the Launchpad's default 'Use wallet funds' mode sign with an EOA. Only Live, Workbench, cartridges, Workshop and NFT-funded launches route through the NFT.

integrations/ (1,720 files) is mostly vendored: 606 Uniswap v4-core/periphery/permit2/solmate files under console/protocol/v4-hook, 537 CCA/Doppler files under official-launch, 364 donor-repo snapshots under github/, and 50 uncompiled Foundry files for 'dave'. First-party Solidity is 1,837 lines: OwnerV4FeeHook (exact-input fee hook accruing ERC-6909 claims, 6,607 B runtime), GenesisV4Launchpad/HookLaunchpad/Router/Position (fixed token + immutable v4 position as ERC-20 LP shares, no admin), HookCreate2Factory, OwnerFeeRouter (64-recipient pull-claim splitter), AWEArtifact/ArtifactAccount (a non-6551 NFT account with epoch-bound ERC-1271 digests), CartridgeRegistry (24,576-byte on-chain game cartridges with launchManifest gating), CreatorItems (ERC-1155 editions), PrismRelay (serverless two-player game), and five thin official-launch adapters. The v4 hook/launchpad/router/fee-router set is the strongest reusable swap+launchpad primitive across the four repos; the RAILGUN route, loopback services, burner wallets and donor copies should be dropped.

components.name: Chain loader + module loader (tokenURI bootstrap)
components.path: web/confluence/chain-loader.mjs, web/confluence/module-loader.mjs, scripts/build-chain-loader.mjs -> contracts/src/confluence/ConfluenceLoader.sol
components.purpose: Dependency-free reader embedded in every token's animation_url: recovers the archived HTML app (schema 1/2 chunks or schema 3 functional runtime) via eth_call at one pinned block, verifies SHA-256, gunzips, builds an import map of data: URLs and document.write()s the app.
design_decisions: Pure-JS SHA-256 because 'SHA-256 works in opaque data URLs, where SubtleCrypto may be unavailable'
Loader is read-only: never requests accounts; RPC comes from an <input id=rpc> (HTTPS/localhost only) or window.ethereum and is stored on window.AWE_CHAIN_RPC

Hard-coded selectors: chunkCount 0xf91f0937, schemaVersion 0x4e2ce6d3, byteLength 0x02823108, readChunk 0x8f5281bf; v3: count 0x334f7ac5, shellIndex 0x7259f506, moduleAt 0xd216d296, depCount 0xb3a840da, dependency 0xb972ae05
'Shell must pin every feature' - the shell's import map must name every module; entries 2..32, <=64 MiB
Docs: 'Embedding the full application twice in tokenURI exceeded practical RPC execution limits; the compact loader avoids that large metadata allocation'
key_functions: assembleFunctionalRuntime(shell, modules) -> import map awe/<path> -> data:text/javascript;base64
components.reuse_notes: Keep as the data-HTML bootstrap; add a web3:// (ERC-5219) route from IPSEITY so marketplaces that strip animation_url scripts still render. Selector tables must be regenerated if the archive contracts change.
security_invariants: Content hash verified before execution
All chunk reads pinned to one block
No account request, no credentials in the loader

Account and all six modules must have code
Every signed action re-asserts owner, currentOwner, mode, sessionEpoch and revision

security_invariants: Worker bytes SHA-verified before Blob URL creation
Private wallet never rendered as a recovery phrase
Lock terminates the worker

website_delivery: From chain: ConfluenceRenderer.render() returns data:application/json whose animation_url is a data:text/html loader ('ANIMA GENESIS — Unfold your artifact', generated from web/confluence/chain-loader.mjs + module-loader.mjs into contracts/src/confluence/ConfluenceLoader.sol). The loader embeds window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY {seed, genome, root, chainId, collection, tokenId, manifest, privacyResource, runtime, sha256, archiveVersion}, takes an HTTPS/localhost RPC URL or window.ethereum, reads the OnchainAppDirectory (schema 2, up to 512 chunks of <=23,000 STOP-prefixed bytes) or OnchainModuleDirectory (schema 3, 'anima.functional-runtime/1', 2..32 gzip module envelopes, 20 feature groups) with raw eth_call at one pinned block, verifies SHA-256 in pure JS, inflates with DecompressionStream, builds an import map awe/<path> -> data:text/javascript;base64 and document.write()s the 7,952,983-byte app (measured 6,080 ms). The Module Workbench is a second 707,014-byte / 31-chunk on-chain HTML; the 15,112,663-byte RAILGUN worker is a ShardedResource recovered on demand. The identical bytes are built to dist/index.html (and root index.html, 477,361 B) by scripts/build-confluence.mjs for development, served at 127.0.0.1:4173. No web3:// route, no page-level CSP, no IPFS; a CORS-enabled read RPC and data-HTML execution are required.
wallet_gating: In-app, repeated, four verifiers. (1) ConfluenceWallet.connect(collection, tokenId) [web/confluence/wallet.mjs:47-156]: assertMintBinding to AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY (collection/token/chain), eth_requestAccounts, at one block reads ownerOf/accountOf/renderSnapshot/modulesOf and throws 'This wallet does not own the selected NFT.' unless ownerOf(tokenId)==signer; the account and six modules (market, vault, journal, ledger, cartridges, exit) must have code; assertOwner() [259] re-checks ownerOf, currentOwner(), mode()==0 and assertReviewContext(revision, epoch) [397] before every signed action; plans expire after 300 s. (2) NFTAccountSession.connect [web/launchpad/account-session.mjs]: ownerOf==signer, collection runtime pinned to IDontFuckingBelieveIt and account to SovereignAccount with immutable masks, currentOwner==owner, mode==0; wrap(plan) -> executeUtility(nonce, deadline, asset, target, value, data, allowance). (3) RegistryAdapter.context() [web/modules/adapter.mjs]: assertOwner plus registry read owner==signer and currentOwner==owner. (4) Cartridges: CartridgeRegistry.launchManifest(id, player) [runtime-contracts/src/CartridgeRegistry.sol:119-136] authorized = player==controller (controller resolved through the parent NFT account), and readCartridge requires holder==account, controller==address, onchainContentAvailable and sha256(contentOf)==contentHash. GAP: the Swap desk (web/v4/desk.mjs) performs no NFT check (RAILGUN shielded wallet by default, else injected wallet); Commons/MLS, Governance, Crosschain, Lifecycle and the Launchpad's default 'Use wallet funds' mode sign with LaunchChain's EOA ('Encryption keys belong to your wallet; selling an NFT does not transfer your private history.'); LaunchParticipant is explicitly for visitors without an NFT. Only Live (NativeMarket/TimeVault/MemoryLedger/WorldLedger/VestedExitVault), Workbench, cartridges, Workshop and NFT-funded launches execute through the token's account.

normalizeRuntime immutable masks gate every contract: changing constructor immutables requires regenerating every artifacts.mjs (v4, hook-artifacts, extensions, commons, workshop, governance, crosschain) or desks refuse to connect
executeUtility allows at most one approved ERC-20 per plan; multi-token actions must be split
Any read-then-sign gap must call assertReviewContext(revision, epoch); plans are single-use and expire
finishRecord demands exactly one Launched event and the finalized tag; chains without finality tags need the ganache fallback
The three selector tables (chain-loader, module-loader, recover-resource) are hand-coded 4-byte constants that must track the Solidity
modulesOf is read from AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY.manifest, a registry separate from the collection; the unified token should expose module addresses itself
GenesisV4 hook addresses must have permission bits 0x00c8; mining is done in the browser and can take up to 1,000,000 attempts
Public RPCs returned HTTP 403 in the authoring environment; all 'live' evidence is chain 31337
preview.html and script/Site-style stale artifacts exist; only dist/ and index.html are current
Immutable on-chain archives mean every bundled dependency (ethers x3) is paid for in gas and cannot be patched
